name: @saflib/templates-dev
description: Docker compose setup for dev environment

scripts.dev: saf-git-hashes && saf-docker prune && saf-docker generate && ./build-images.sh && docker compose --env-file env.dev --env-file .env -f docker-compose.yaml up
scripts.up: saf-git-hashes && saf-docker prune && saf-docker generate && ./build-images.sh && docker compose --env-file env.dev --env-file .env -f docker-compose.yaml up --detach
scripts.down: saf-docker generate && docker compose --env-file env.dev --env-file .env -f docker-compose.yaml down
